gaps.explanation: Bond Fund disbursements are missing from detail. The Combined Statement of Modified Cash Disbursements budget schedule in the trim (p13, printed p29) has only the General, Street and TIF columns. Its right half, with the Bond Fund column (printed p30), is not in the trim, so detail holds General 207,573.38 + Street 200,167.13 + TIF 5,992.01 = 413,732.52. The governmental funds statement prints the Bond Fund column on p7 (Exhibit III page 1, right half): Dues and Fees 15.00, Principal 95,000.00, Interest 7,098.75. Its total disbursements are 102,113.75 (p9). 413,732.52 + 15.00 + 95,000.00 + 7,098.75 = 515,846.27 = the statement total (p9). Bond Fund receipts are already in detail from p12.
